info.name: NVIDIA VM-Series Auto-Scale Licensing (CSP + SCM)
info.description: Validation collection for the Software NGFW Licensing API (auth code create, deactivate, delete) and the SCM device decommission workaround. Requests marked DESTRUCTIVE change licensing state, so only point them at a lab credit pool.

request.description: OAuth2 client credentials for the fwflex-service scope. The endpoint and format come from KB article kA14u000000XhzQCAS (the activation guide omits them): client_id/client_secret go in the form body.

exec: pm.test("HTTP 200", () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));
// TMS returns HTTP 200 with {"status":400,"error":...} on failures, so check the body too
pm.test("no error envelope", () => { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b && b.error && b.status >= 400, b && b.message).to.not.be.ok; });
const j = pm.response.json();
pm.test("has access_token", () => pm.expect(j.access_token).to.be.a("string"));
pm.collectionVariables.set("csp_token", j.access_token);

request.description: Pick the creditPoolId for the profile.

exec: pm.test("HTTP 200", () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));
// TMS returns HTTP 200 with {"status":400,"error":...} on failures, so check the body too
pm.test("no error envelope", () => { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b && b.error && b.status >= 400, b && b.message).to.not.be.ok; });
const d = pm.response.json().data || [];
pm.test("has pools", () => pm.expect(d.length).to.be.above(0));
if (!pm.variables.get("credit_pool_id") && d.length) pm.collectionVariables.set("credit_pool_id", d[0].creditPoolId);

request.description: Device `id` is a UUID; the serial is expected in `name` (or `serial_number`). Confirm against the first onboarded firewall; scm.py's device_serial() follows the same order.

exec: pm.test("HTTP 200", () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));
// TMS returns HTTP 200 with {"status":400,"error":...} on failures, so check the body too
pm.test("no error envelope", () => { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b && b.error && b.status >= 400, b && b.message).to.not.be.ok; });
const r = pm.response.json(); const d = Array.isArray(r) ? r : (r.data || []);
const s = pm.variables.get("serial");
const m = d.find(x => (x.serial_number || x.serial || x.name) === s);
if (m) pm.collectionVariables.set("scm_device_id", m.id);
